facts.fact: Teraco operates eight data centres in South Africa across five campuses, per its CEO; the article gives no opening dates, so as_of is the published date.
Africa Data Centres (Cassava) operates three primary data centres in South Africa, including Cape Town and Johannesburg facilities; no opening dates given, so as_of is the published date.

note: Equinix Cape Town project paused (planned, not in service); Vantage, NTT, OADC named as expanding without facts.
